title: Two scribes in the Great Isaiah Scroll: new evidence from handwriting
summary: Independent analyses of character shapes distinguish two groups across the scroll’s 54 columns, consistent with two scribes alternating around the manuscript’s midpoint. This is statistical evidence from one artifact; the writers’ identities are unknown, and other explanations for the differences are not entirely ruled out.

evidence.tested: Independent analyses of character shapes across 54 columns separated two groups, treated as statistical evidence from one artifact.
evidence.unknown: Not reported in the abstract read.
